description: Smooth the space boundary (Chaikin / Bézier), optionally kept inside + curve-shortened.
instructions:
Smooths the Space boundary → one output per input Space.

TYPES (`type`)
• chaikin — corner-cutting; rounds every corner (classic, fast).
• bezier — Bézier corner fillets.

`level` (0–1) sets the smoothing strength. `restrictInside` keeps the smoothed curve within the original polygon (no bulging outward — keep ON for habitable rooms so walls never cross the boundary). `curveShortening` (%) adds a post curvature-shortening pass to relax kinks.

TIP: run Resample (densify) BEFORE Smoothing for cleaner curves. `outputMode=single` bundles every smoothed Space onto one handle.
